SCIM.TITLE: Directory sync (SCIM)
SCIM.DESCRIPTION: Your identity provider adds people to this workspace, deactivates them when they leave and sets their role from their groups. Only addresses on your verified domains are synced.
SCIM.NOT_ENABLED: Directory sync is not enabled on this instance. The operator turns it on (SSO_ENABLED and SCIM_WEBHOOK_URL, see docs/sso.md).
SCIM.NOT_CONFIGURED: Directory sync needs single sign-on, which is switched on but not fully set up on this instance yet. Ask the administrator or support team of this instance to finish the setup.
SCIM.OWNER_ONLY: Only a workspace owner can change directory sync. You can see its status.
SCIM.CREDENTIALS_NOTICE: Enter these in your identity provider's SCIM provisioning settings now. The token is shown only once: if you lose it, rotate it.
SCIM.VERIFY_DOMAIN_FIRST: Verify an email domain first: the directory only provisions addresses on your verified domains.

RESYNC_ERRORS.scim_unavailable: the directory service was not reachable.
RESYNC_ERRORS.auth_unavailable: the account service was not reachable; some people were skipped.
RESYNC_ERRORS.mass_deprovision_refused: it would have deactivated too many members at once, so nothing was changed. Check your identity provider, then resync (you can force it).
RESYNC_ERRORS.resync_failed: something went wrong; it is retried tonight.

SCIM.STALE_DIRECTORY: The directory before the last rotation could not be deleted yet, so its old token may still be accepted. It is retried with every resync.
SCIM.ROTATION_GRACE: Token rotated: until {{time}} a resync deactivates nobody, while your identity provider sends everyone to the new directory.
SCIM.TOKEN_HINT: The bearer token was shown when the directory was created; rotate it if you need a new one.
SCIM.GROUPS_DESCRIPTION: Give a group a workspace role; someone in several groups gets the highest. People in no mapped group get the role for new members ({{role}}, under Policy). The billing owner is never changed, owners' roles are never changed, and the role of members you invited by hand is left alone.
SCIM.NO_GROUPS: No groups yet. Assign groups to the SCIM app at your identity provider (push groups).
SCIM.CHECK_ROLE_HINT: After the token rotation several earlier groups had this name, so its role was not carried over. Choose it again.
SCIM.CONFIRM_ROTATE: Rotate the SCIM token? The base URL and the token both change, and the current token stops working at once. You then enter the new ones at your identity provider, which sends its users and groups again. Members keep their access meanwhile.
SCIM.ROTATE_STALE: The previous directory could not be deleted yet, so its token may still be accepted. Retry the clean-up below.
SCIM.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete the directory? Members stay in the workspace with their current role, but your identity provider no longer adds, deactivates or updates them. People it had deactivated are enabled again where a seat is free; the others stay deactivated. Remove the SCIM app at your identity provider too.
SCIM.DELETED_LEFT: Directory deleted. Members were kept; {{count}} deactivated by it stay deactivated because no seat is free.
SCIM.CONFIRM_FORCE: This resync would deactivate {{count}} of {{total}} members, more than the safety limit, so nothing was changed. Check your identity provider's assignments first. Deactivate them anyway?
SCIM.CLEANUP_FAILED: The previous directory could not be deleted yet.

SSO_UI.DIAG_ADDRESS: Your identity provider sent an address at <1>{{domain}}</1>. This workspace's verified domains: {{domains}}.
SSO_UI.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete “{{name}}”? Members can no longer sign in with it.
SSO_UI.TEST_FIRST: Test it before you require single sign-on.
SSO_UI.OIDC_NOTE: Testing may reuse this browser’s current sign-in at your identity provider. Test in a private window, or sign out of your identity provider first (Microsoft Entra ID: <1>https://login.microsoftonline.com/logout.srf</1>).
SSO_UI.CREATED: Connection created. Test it, then enable it.
SSO_UI.METADATA_HTTPS: Must be https and on the public internet.
SSO_UI.CLIENT_SECRET_HINT: Stored by the single sign-on service only; it is never shown again.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_SAML_1: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, open Enterprise applications → New application → Create your own application (non-gallery).
SSO_UI.ENTRA_SAML_2: Single sign-on → SAML → Basic SAML Configuration: Identifier (Entity ID) <v>{{entityId}}</v> and Reply URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL) <v>{{acsUrl}}</v>.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_SAML_3: Attributes & Claims: the email address claim must be <v>user.mail</v> (or <v>user.userprincipalname</v> if your users have no mailbox and sign in with their email address).
SSO_UI.ENTRA_SAML_4: SAML Certificates: copy the App Federation Metadata Url into “Metadata URL” here, or download the Federation Metadata XML and paste it.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_SAML_5: Users and groups: assign the people who may sign in.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_OIDC_1: App registrations → New registration. Redirect URI: platform Web, <v>{{uri}}</v>.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_OIDC_2: Certificates & secrets → New client secret. Copy its value (not its ID) into “Client secret” here.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_OIDC_3: Token configuration → Add optional claim → ID token → email.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_OIDC_4: Here: Discovery URL <v>https://login.microsoftonline.com/[tenant-ID]/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration</v>, Client ID = the Application (client) ID.
SSO_UI.ENTRA_NOTE: Every user needs an email address in Entra ID (the Email field of their account), on one of this workspace’s verified domains. Test in a private window, or sign out of Microsoft first, so that you sign in with the account you mean to test.
SSO_UI.KEYCLOAK_BODY: Create an OpenID Connect client with Client authentication on (confidential). Valid redirect URIs must be exactly <v>{{uri}}</v>. Keep the <v>email</v> client scope assigned, and give users an email address.
SSO_UI.REQUIRED_NOW_one: Single sign-on is now required. {{count}} session was signed out.
SSO_UI.REQUIRED_NOW_other: Single sign-on is now required. {{count}} sessions were signed out.
SSO_UI.NO_LONGER_REQUIRED: Single sign-on is no longer required.
SSO_UI.DEFAULT_ROLE_HINT: Someone signing in with single sign-on for the first time joins this workspace with this role. Existing members keep theirs.
SSO_UI.REQUIRE_HINT: Addresses on these domains can then only sign in through your identity provider: sign-in codes by email and Google are refused, here and on every workspace.
SSO_UI.REVOKE_NOW: Also sign out members on these domains now, so their next sign-in goes through your identity provider (your own session stays).
SSO_UI.REQUIRE_PRECONDITION: Verify a domain, enable a connection and test it successfully first.
SSO_UI.BREAK_GLASS: <1>Break-glass:</1> the workspace’s owners can always sign in with a code sent by email, even when single sign-on is required, so a broken identity provider can’t lock everyone out. Keep the owners’ mailboxes safe.
SSO_UI.LOAD_FAILED: Single sign-on settings couldn’t be loaded.
SSO_UI.OWNERS_ONLY: Only a workspace owner can change single sign-on: a connection decides who every address on your verified domains is, the owners’ included. You can view the settings and test a connection.
SSO_UI.DOMAINS_DESC: Single sign-on applies to your verified email domains only. Someone your identity provider signs in with an address on another domain is refused.
SSO_UI.IDP_DETAILS_DESC: Enter these when you register BetterCollected as an application at your identity provider.
SSO_UI.SAML_METADATA_HINT: Some identity providers can read the two values above from this.
SSO_UI.EMAIL_NOTE: Your identity provider must send the user’s email address (SAML: the NameID or an email attribute; OIDC: the email claim).
SSO_UI.CONNECTIONS_DESC: One connection signs members in at a time: enabling one disables the others. A connection can only be enabled after a successful test.
SSO_UI.NEEDS_DOMAIN: A connection needs a verified email domain. <1/> first.
SSO_UI.ONLY_ADMINS: Only workspace admins can manage single sign-on.
SSO_UI.PAGE_INTRO: Let your members sign in with your organisation’s identity provider. People who sign in this way for the first time join this workspace automatically, as long as there is a free seat. Your identity provider decides who that is, so only connect one you control.
SSO_UI.DOMAINS_ONLY_ADMINS: Only workspace admins can manage domains.

RESPONSE_IMPORT.TITLE: Import responses from a CSV file
RESPONSE_IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: Add responses collected elsewhere to this form. The file is read here, checked with the same rules as a respondent's answers, and removed as soon as the import is done.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.LIMITS: A .csv file of at most {{mb}} MB and {{rows}} rows, saved as UTF-8 or Windows-1252, with commas or semicolons. An Excel file (.xlsx) is not accepted: save it as CSV first.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.FORMAT_HINT: A file exported from this form can be imported as it is: its columns are recognised.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.MAP_HELP: Choose for each column of your file the question it belongs to. Columns you leave out are not imported.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.SKIP_INVALID: If a row has a problem, import the other rows and skip that one
RESPONSE_IMPORT.SKIP_INVALID_HELP: Without this, nothing is imported as long as a single row has a problem.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.NOTE_responder_ignored: The responder column is not imported: imported responses are anonymous.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.NOTE_response_id_ignored: The response ID is not imported: imported responses get their own.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.NOTE_calculated_ignored: A calculated question is not imported: it is worked out again from the answers.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.NOTE_group_rows_ignored: A repeating group exported as a separate table cannot be imported from this file.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.NOTE_type_unsupported: This kind of question cannot be imported (files, drawn signatures and tables).
RESPONSE_IMPORT.PROBLEMS_TRUNCATED: Only the first {{count}} problems are shown. Fix these and check again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.CONFIRM: I confirm that I may store this data for this form and that I will treat it as I treat my other responses.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.CONFIRM_HELP: Imported responses carry no consent record from a respondent. They show as imported and can be undone for 14 days.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.IMPORTING_HELP: You can close this window; the import continues and the result is kept here.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.DONE_NOTHING_FIRED: Nothing was sent: no mails, webhooks or other actions run for imported responses.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.UNDO_CONFIRM: Delete the {{count}} responses of this import? This cannot be undone.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.UNDONE: The import was undone: {{count}} responses were deleted.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.IMPORTED_TITLE: This response was imported from a CSV file
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_unsupported_format: This file is not a CSV text file. Save the spreadsheet as CSV (comma or semicolon separated) and try again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_too_large: This file is too large (at most {{mb}} MB).
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_too_many_rows: This file has too many rows (at most {{rows}}). Split it and import it in parts.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_too_many_columns: This file has too many columns.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_cell_too_long: A cell in row {{row}} is far too long.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_header_too_long: A column heading is too long.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_no_header: The first row must hold the column headings.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_no_rows: This file has headings but no rows.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_unreadable_encoding: The characters of this file cannot be read. Save it as CSV in UTF-8 and try again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_unreadable_file: This file cannot be read as CSV (check the quotes around row {{row}}).
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_rate_limited: You uploaded files for this form too often. Try again later.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_import_in_progress: An import of this form is already running. Wait until it has finished.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_workspace_busy: Several imports of this workspace are running. Try again in a few minutes.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_not_ready: This import can no longer be run. Start again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_needs_confirmation: Confirm that you may store this data first.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_no_mapping: Match at least one column to a question.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_duplicate_target: Two columns are matched to the same question.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_unknown_target: A column is matched to a question this form no longer has.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_target_not_importable: A column is matched to something that cannot be imported.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_unknown_column: A matched column is not in the file.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_form_not_published: Publish the form before importing responses.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_form_not_importable: Responses can only be imported into a form collected here.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_rollback_expired: This import can no longer be undone.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_not_rollbackable: Only a finished import can be undone.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_forbidden: You are not allowed to import responses.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_validation_failed: Some rows have problems, so nothing was imported.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_nothing_to_import: There were no valid rows to import.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_form_full: The form's response limit would be exceeded, so nothing was imported.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_form_changed: The form changed since the check. Check the file again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_permission_removed: You are no longer allowed to import responses.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_file_gone: The file is no longer available. Upload it again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_file_unreadable: The file could not be read again. Upload it again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_store_failed: The responses could not be stored. Nothing was imported; try again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_build_failed: The import failed. Nothing was imported; try again.
RESPONSE_IMPORT.ERROR_queue_timeout: The import was not picked up in time. Nothing was imported; try again.
